job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

Design and develop applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) for real-world use cases, including building and optimizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and prompt strategies. Work with structured and unstructured data, and integrate AI solutions with backend systems using Python and Node.js through APIs.




Preferred candidate profile

4+ years of experience in AI/ML with hands-on exposure to LLM-based application development
Strong proficiency in Python with working knowledge of Node.js
Experience in building and deploying RAG-based systems and prompt engineering
Hands-on with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, or Weaviate
Experience in developing end-to-end AI solutions and integrating APIs
Good understanding of scalable backend systems and performance optimization
Prior experience in fintech or data-driven applications is a plus
Strong problem-solving ability and analytical mindset
Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
